caseName: Securities & Exchange Commission v. Chenery Corp.
caseNameFull: Securities & Exchange Commission v. Chenery Corporation and Securities & Exchange Commission v. Federal Water & Gas Corp.
attorneys: Solicitor General McGrath and Roger S. Foster for petitioner., Spencer Gordon and Charles A. Horsky for the Chenery Corporation et al., and Allen S. Hubbard for the Federal Water & Gas Corp., respondents.

opinions.text:
Petition for writs of certiorari to the United States Court of Appeals for the District of Columbia granted.

Mr. Justice Douglas took no part in the consideration or decision of this application.
